name: Buffer preparation & hold suite
notes: Sized off diafiltration buffer demand. GAP pending diavolumes (Q-020).

name: Ligation reactor
sizing_basis: Batch volume = product mass / reactor concentration (P-CONC-LIG)
notes: Jacketed, temperature-controlled, low-shear mixing. Sizing GAP pending P-CONC-LIG.

name: Clarification / enzyme-separation filter
sizing_basis: Throughput L/m2 for depth+clarifying; or centrifuge if immobilised enzyme
notes: If immobilised ligase: enzyme removed here by filtration/centrifugation (see filtration finding). Cell-free-extract routes raise the protein/endotoxin load here (R-017).

name: UF/DF skid (TFF)
sizing_basis: Membrane area from flux (LMH) and batch volume
moc_candidate: PES/regenerated cellulose membrane; SS or single-use flow path
notes: MWCO well BELOW the product mass, not above it: an oligonucleotide should be at least twice the MWCO for robust retention (SRC-GRONKE-2023) and the vendor rule is a MWCO 3-6x lower than the molecule (SRC-SCHWARTZ-BPI-2003, SRC-PALL-TFF); the only siRNA optimisation study ran at 10 kDa (SRC-ZYDNEY-2025). The previously asserted '30 kDa upper limit' is struck (Q-035). Area GAP pending flux (Q-036).

name: Evaporator
sizing_basis: Heat duty Q=U*A*dTlm; area from duty and U; plus a minimum-wetting-rate floor on feed per unit tube perimeter (turndown limit, R-013)
notes: Short-residence type (falling/wiped/thin film) favoured to protect the duplex. Turndown is set by the minimum wetting rate (~0.10-0.22 kg/m/s for water; SRC-HUGHES-2024): a small batch cannot run single-pass and must recirculate (R-013, R-004). Type selection and U pending Q-018.

name: Spray dryer
sizing_basis: Water evaporation rate; drying gas mass & heat duty
notes: Atomiser and inlet/outlet design pending stream F. Dried organic powder brings dust-explosion controls into scope (R-016). Sizing GAP.

name: CIP/SIP system
sizing_basis: Circulation flow for largest vessel; evaporator & dryer are hard-to-clean
notes: Tier-2 detail. Spray-dryer/evaporator CIP flagged as a design risk (R-008); cleaning validation needs a health-based exposure limit that does not yet exist (R-015).
